description: Replace one runtime setting partition. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth), settings.write, and the version the client last read. The change, its revision and its audit event commit in one transaction.

values.description: Complete partition value. The server validates every key against the partition schema and rejects unknown keys.

errors.name: SettingsConflict
errors.description: The submitted expectedVersion does not match the current partition version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The section or values are not valid.
